about_the_game:
Prepare for an unparalleled combat experience with Elite Forces NEXT-GEN! This cutting-edge multiplayer game immerses you in futuristic battlefields where strategy and skill determine victory.

Key Features:

Real-Time Multiplayer Action: Join players worldwide in synchronous tank battles, showcasing your combat prowess.

Diverse Game Modes: Engage in various thrilling modes, including Team Deathmatch, Free For All, and Capture the Flag, each demanding unique strategies.

Advanced Weaponry: Equip your agent with a vast arsenal, from precision rifles to powerful grenade launchers, allowing for customizable combat styles.

Tactical Gameplay: Utilize features like sliding, jumping, crouching, and running to outmaneuver opponents and gain the upper hand.

AI Opponents: Hone your skills against intelligent bots that provide a challenging and immersive experience.

Robust Communication: Coordinate with your team using integrated voice chat, enhancing strategic planning and execution.

Customizable Classes: Choose from multiple player classes, each with distinct abilities and load-outs, to suit your preferred combat role.

Stunning Graphics: Experience high-quality visuals optimized for high-end devices, bringing futuristic battlefields to life.


Join the ranks of elite commanders in Elite Forces NEXT-GEN and dominate the cyber battlefield!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 3.3 Ghz to 3.69 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: NVIDIA Virtual Audio Device (Wave Extensible) (WDM)
